title: Create comprehensive admin vendor and product management dashboard

requirements.summary: Create a comprehensive vendor overview section in the admin dashboard displaying all vendors in a table or card layout with columns for vendor name, business address, total products count, orders assigned count, and quick enable/disable toggle button for each vendor
acceptanceCriteria: Admin dashboard displays all registered vendors
Each vendor row shows: business name, full address, total products count, assigned orders count
Enable/disable toggle button is present and functional for each vendor
Clicking enable/disable updates vendor status in real-time

file_operations.description: Extend the existing vendor table to include new columns for 'Total Products' and 'Orders Assigned'. Add these columns after the business name and address columns. Fetch product counts and order counts from backend queries. Ensure the enable/disable toggle button functionality is maintained. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing admin-only access.

Add query hooks useGetVendorProductCount and useGetVendorOrderCount that fetch the total products and assigned orders count for each vendor from the backend. These hooks should accept vendorId as a parameter and return the numeric counts. Use React Query's caching strategy to optimize performance when displaying multiple vendors.

requirements.summary: Add a drill-down view in the admin dashboard that displays all products for a selected vendor, showing product name, description, price, quantity, SKU, status (enabled/disabled), and thumbnail images of uploaded photos
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking on a vendor in the vendor overview opens a detailed products view
Products view displays all products created by that vendor
Each product shows: name, description, price in rupees, quantity, SKU, enabled/disabled status
Product photos are displayed as thumbnails or in a gallery format
View includes navigation back to vendor overview

file_operations.description: Create a new component that displays all products for a selected vendor in a detailed view. Accept vendorId and vendorName as props. Use the existing useListVendorProducts query hook to fetch products. Display products in a grid or table layout with columns for: product name, description, price in rupees, quantity, SKU, enabled/disabled status badge, and thumbnail images. Include a back button to return to the vendor overview. Use blob-storage component's ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() method to display product photo thumbnails. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing photo display.

Add click handlers to vendor table rows that open the VendorProductsView component in a dialog or navigate to it. Pass the selected vendor's ID and business name as props. Implement state management to track which vendor is selected for drill-down view. Add visual affordance (cursor pointer, hover effect) to indicate rows are clickable.

requirements.summary: Implement product editing functionality in the admin dashboard that allows admin to edit any product field (name, description, price, quantity, photos) and automatically syncs those changes so they are visible to the vendor who created the product
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can click an edit button on any product in the vendor products view
Edit form allows modification of product name, description, price, quantity
Admin can add or remove product photos during editing
After saving, changes are immediately reflected in the vendor's product list
Vendor sees the updated product information in their dashboard without manual refresh

file_operations.description: Create a dialog component that displays a form for editing product details. Accept product object as prop and pre-fill all form fields (name, description, price, quantity). Include photo management that displays current photos using ExternalBlob.getDirectURL(), allows removing existing photos, and uploading new ones using the blob-storage component with progress tracking via withUploadProgress(). Use the useUpdateProductByAdmin mutation hook for submission. Show loading state during save and display success toast on completion. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing photo management.

Add an edit button to each product row or card that opens the ProductEditDialog component. Pass the selected product data to the dialog. Handle dialog open/close state. After successful edit, the product list will automatically refresh via React Query cache invalidation.

requirements.summary: Add a React Query mutation hook useUpdateProductByAdmin in useQueries.ts that calls the backend updateProductByAdmin function and invalidates product-related queries to refresh the UI
acceptanceCriteria: Hook accepts productId and updated product data as parameters
Hook calls the backend updateProductByAdmin function via actor
On success, invalidates 'products', 'vendorProducts', and 'allProducts' queries
Returns mutation status (loading, error, success) for UI feedback

file_operations.description: Add a new mutation hook useUpdateProductByAdmin that accepts UpdateProductRequest (productId, name, description, priceRupees, quantity, sku, enabled, photos as ExternalBlob array) as parameter. Call actor.updateProductByAdmin with the request data. On success, invalidate query keys: ['products'], ['vendorProducts'], and ['allProducts'] to trigger UI refresh. Return mutation status including isLoading, isError, isSuccess, and error for UI feedback. Use the existing mutation pattern from other hooks in the file.

requirements.summary: Create a ProductEditDialog component in frontend that displays a form with all product fields pre-filled, allows admin to modify values and photos, and submits changes using the useUpdateProductByAdmin mutation hook
acceptanceCriteria: Dialog opens with current product data pre-filled in form fields
Form includes fields for name, description, price, quantity
Photo management allows viewing current photos, removing photos, and uploading new ones
Submit button triggers useUpdateProductByAdmin mutation
Success shows confirmation toast and closes dialog
Error displays appropriate error message

file_operations.description: Create a dialog component using shadcn/ui Dialog components. Accept product prop with all product fields. Pre-fill form inputs with current product values (name, description, price in rupees, quantity). Implement photo management section that displays current photos as thumbnails using ExternalBlob.getDirectURL(), allows removing individual photos with a delete button, and supports uploading new photos with progress tracking using ExternalBlob.fromBytes().withUploadProgress(). Use useUpdateProductByAdmin mutation hook for form submission. Display loading spinner on submit button during mutation. Show success toast notification on successful save and close dialog. Display error message if mutation fails. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing photo handling.
